scope: Complete Revision 6 first release: 36 features, preserving all 35 Revision 5 features and adding E1 extensible tools, integrations and skills. Production personal connectors and wake-word detection remain later scope.
notice: Planning manifest only. No app implemented or tests run. Tier assignments are minimums; scenario-level coverage must follow the full specification.

features.name: Spoken brainstorming
features.required_behavior: Live transcription to Astra; concise responses that develop ideas and notice tradeoffs
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Real discussion with pauses and changes of mind

features.name: Full-duplex interruption
features.required_behavior: Speak over the assistant or press Stop; queued text/audio is canceled
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Both voice providers; physical speaker cutoff

features.name: Patient turns
features.required_behavior: Normal and Patient endpoint settings; manual talk/commit fallback
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Unfinished thoughts do not routinely trigger early replies

features.name: Astra brain
features.required_behavior: Text/image reasoning and bounded visual retrieval tools
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Real model access; brain unchanged during voice fallback

features.name: ElevenLabs voice
features.required_behavior: Chosen voice ID, preview, validation, streaming output
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Actual configured voice plays

features.name: OpenAI speech
features.required_behavior: Works alone; fallback follows explicit policy
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Missing key, provider failure, and interrupted fallback

features.name: Personality
features.required_behavior: Editable instructions; English default and explicit language switching
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Short useful spoken turns; respectful challenge

features.name: Conversation continuity
features.required_behavior: Active context, heard-answer history, bounded summaries
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Interrupted answers do not introduce unheard facts

features.name: Notes and history
features.required_behavior: Optional saved transcripts, explicit Save idea, export/delete
features.spec_acceptance_summary: No external development actions from casual discussion

features.name: Live view
features.required_behavior: Webcam/robot preview, current frame, camera controls
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Fresh image IDs and visible capture state

features.name: Whiteboard and phone reading
features.required_behavior: Detailed source images, selectable crops, overview plus detail; ask for a better view when needed
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Real handwriting, diagrams, and phone screens

features.name: Visual ring buffer
features.required_behavior: Approximately ten minutes at 1 fps, bounded by bytes too
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Time/size eviction and visible retained range

features.name: Visual history tools
features.required_behavior: Browse timeline, search metadata, inspect original frame/crop, capture now
features.spec_acceptance_summary: References to earlier objects resolve to actual evidence

features.name: Speech/image alignment
features.required_behavior: Capture timestamps linked to spoken turns and events
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Object shown during a question remains findable after being lowered

features.name: Session reference images
features.required_behavior: Explicitly pin a small set of boards/images; version changed boards
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Discussion can outlast ten-minute rolling history

features.name: Image input fallback
features.required_behavior: Upload or paste a screenshot/photo on the PC
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Read detailed material when optical capture is poor

features.name: Evidence display
features.required_behavior: Show the images/times used for the answer and uncertainty
features.spec_acceptance_summary: User can correct the selected reference

features.name: Person presence
features.required_behavior: Stable presence/absence and entry/exit events
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Occlusion does not repeatedly produce greetings

features.name: Object detection
features.required_behavior: Small pretrained detector; supported labels, boxes, scores
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Labels are declared; unknown objects remain available to Astra vision

features.name: Wave detection
features.required_behavior: Hand landmarks across time plus a wave state machine
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Static open palm, drawing and robot camera motion are negative cases

features.name: Event log
features.required_behavior: Timestamped presence, wave, supported object-appearance, and scene-change events
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Events link to retained frames where available

features.name: Trigger rules
features.required_behavior: Editable prompt, enable toggle, conditions, cooldown, expiry and action
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Deterministic suppression and cancellation tests

features.name: Greeting presets
features.required_behavior: Working person-entry and wave presets; initially disabled during setup
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Enabled presets can start a short conversation

features.name: Aware mode
features.required_behavior: Local perception outside a conversation; explicit active state
features.spec_acceptance_summary: No continuous cloud reasoning or transcription while merely aware

features.name: Restraint
features.required_behavior: User speech wins; repeat suppression, quiet times and interruption backoff
features.spec_acceptance_summary: No event storm or stale greetings

features.name: Physical expression
features.required_behavior: Small acknowledgment/listening/speaking cues; motion off switch
features.spec_acceptance_summary: SDK bounds and single motion owner; PC uses a state indicator

features.name: PC-only mode
features.required_behavior: Native Windows backend plus local browser devices
features.spec_acceptance_summary: No Reachy, simulator, WSL or robot media stack needed

features.name: PC-assisted Reachy
features.required_behavior: Robot handles physical media and stop; PC handles brain orchestration, history and perception
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Fake edge integration now; real Wi-Fi acceptance after arrival

features.name: Standalone profile
features.required_behavior: Same core can run onboard with qualified reduced workloads
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Hardware performance report; full-rate vision is not assumed

features.name: Control UI
features.required_behavior: Session/mode controls, devices, voice, vision, history, triggers and diagnostics
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Clear setup and active state

features.name: Recovery
features.required_behavior: Bounded queues, reconnect, device-loss handling, local watchdog
features.spec_acceptance_summary: No stale audio/events replay after recovery

features.name: Diagnostics and budget
features.required_behavior: Stage latency, effective fps, resource use, storage and provider usage
features.spec_acceptance_summary: Actual values distinguished from estimates

features.name: Thumbs-up / thumbs-down conversational responses
features.required_behavior: Stable live-camera yes/no input bound to an unexpired question; release rearming, speech priority, conflict suppression and feedback; no screen/upload/history turns
features.spec_acceptance_summary: 20 examples per thumb class and 20 negatives; >=90% recall per class, <=1 false response; deterministic ownership and source-isolation gates

features.name: Continuous desktop screen sharing
features.required_behavior: Explicit continuous visual-only browser sharing alongside camera; source-aware current/history/crops/pins, shared global budgets and source-scoped clearing
features.spec_acceptance_summary: 12 real screen scenarios, source attribution/readability, shared limits, capture/permission lifecycle, clearing and interruption

features.name: Search project documents during conversation
features.required_behavior: Configured projects; bounded local incremental read-only index and Astra search/read with cited snippets, exclusions, isolation and removal
features.spec_acceptance_summary: 30 supported files across 3 projects plus 12 boundary fixtures; 45 answerable query variants and 10 absent-answer queries; retrieval/citation/update/cancellation gates

features.name: Extensible tools, integrations and skills
features.required_behavior: Working shared registry/executor, MCP stdio/Streamable HTTP and direct adapters, private credentials, trusted on-demand workflows, account/action policies, exact confirmations, durable reconciliation, event ingress and controls; test-only fake calendar/sample workflow, no real personal connector accounts
features.spec_acceptance_summary: All Revision 6 E1 behavioral gates: actual MCP round trips, discovery/schema/capability/account isolation, skills, confirmation binding, cancellation/duplicates/reconciliation, injection resistance, events and immediate interruption
